access_note: fdc.nal.usda.gov could not be reached from the environment used to compile this dataset (the site is a JavaScript application that returns no content to a fetch, its public API demo key was rate-limited, and the sandbox network blocked the host). Every FDC ID and nutrient value below was therefore read from a public FoodData Central mirror (getfoodfacts.com (public FoodData Central mirror)). No record was inspected on the USDA site itself. source_url points at the canonical USDA record so values can be independently checked; mirror_url is the page actually read.
